authority.note: This proof shows added commander-dependence resolution, not commander-value truth or a deck decision.

limitations: Accepted Blueprint commander roles existed, but declared wins/engines/packages and Spellbook lines were not systematically partitioned by explicit commander dependence.
The prior simulator had no commander-unavailable or starting-tax counterfactual mode.
No single Step D record kept structural strategic routes and dynamic counterfactual dimensions in a common non-scoring evidence vector.

conclusion: Step D now distinguishes declared commander-linked strategic routes from independent routes and has a paired dynamic counterfactual architecture without collapsing either into a score; full dynamic closure remains an explicit frozen-local-cache item.
limitations: The demonstrated gain is structural/architectural until real dynamic outputs are generated locally.
Explicit commander-reference absence is not proof of zero commander value.
Counterfactual goldfish results will remain bounded test evidence, not multiplayer win rates.
Meaningful progress remains a vector; heterogeneous events are not summed into a synthetic score.
Accepted Blueprint commander-role judgments remain higher-value strategic context than these derived counts.
